tb1.special.vengefulheart.title: Vengeful Heart Event Chart
tb1.special.vengefulheart.credit: Uploaded by Alpha12 of the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.special.arachnobot.title: Arachnobot's Tale Event (+ Chart)
tb1.special.arachnobot.credit: Chart made by Rydia of the Terra Battle Forum (original chart link is dead; showing the wiki's official banner instead)

tb1.8b.golem.title: 8-Bit Golem Strikes Back
tb1.8b.golem.credit: Repeatable event quest (3 difficulty tiers) to recruit 8-Bit Golem Λ; the boss changes behavior at 30% HP, and the hardest tier can spawn extra "Metal Rocker" adds -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.8b.hisoalien.title: 8-Bit Hiso Alien Strikes Back
tb1.8b.hisoalien.credit: Repeatable event quest to recruit 8-Bit Hiso Alien Λ, featuring poison and time floor traps and lopsided elemental resistances against the boss -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.8b.orbling.title: 8-Bit Orbling Strikes Back
tb1.8b.orbling.credit: Repeatable event quest to recruit 8-Bit Orbling Λ; contains Kinetic traps, deals double damage to Beastfolk allies, and the boss changes behavior at 30% HP -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.8b.spinetrich.title: 8-Bit Spinetrich Strikes Back
tb1.8b.spinetrich.credit: Repeatable event quest to recruit 8-Bit Spinetrich Λ; the boss switches between spear and sword mid-fight, deals double damage to Stonefolk, and heals from Darkness attacks at the hardest tier -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.kino.bahamut.title: Bahamut Kino Strikes Back
tb1.kino.bahamut.credit: Repeatable event quest (added in Version 4.6.0) to recruit Bahamut Kino Λ; defeating the boss at the hardest tier spawns the true Bahamut alongside three ice-only-damageable "mini" Bahamut Kinos -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.kino.kraken.title: Kraken Kino Strikes Back
tb1.kino.kraken.credit: Repeatable event quest to recruit Kraken Kino Λ, distinguished by lopsided weapon damage (sword strong, bow/spear nearly useless) and double damage dealt to Lizardfolk allies -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.kino.leviathan.title: Leviathan Kino Strikes Back
tb1.kino.leviathan.credit: Repeatable event quest (added in Version 4.6.0) to recruit Leviathan Kino Λ; at the hardest tier, damage dealt before the boss flees determines how many "Metal Rocker" adds appear in the following fight -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.kino.lich.title: Lich Kino Strikes Back
tb1.kino.lich.credit: Repeatable event quest across three escalating tiers to recruit Lich Kino Λ and farm event trading items; a "Metal Rocker" can spawn at the hardest tier -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.kino.marilith.title: Marilith Kino Strikes Back
tb1.kino.marilith.credit: Repeatable event quest to recruit Marilith Kino Λ; male party characters take a stacking ATK/MATK debuff by tier, its signature gimmick -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.kino.mechanic.title: Mechanic Kino Strikes Back
tb1.kino.mechanic.credit: Repeatable event quest to recruit Mechanic Kino Λ; escalating floor-trap damage per tier, double damage against Lizardfolk-type units, and the boss can revive its adds on the final floor -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.kino.odin.title: Odin Kino Strikes Back
tb1.kino.odin.credit: Repeatable event quest to recruit Odin Kino Λ; the hardest tier branches into a tougher route if the team's average level is 80+ and the opening battle clears within 2 turns -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.kino.slugosaur.title: Slugosaur Kino Strikes Back
tb1.kino.slugosaur.credit: Repeatable event quest to recruit Slugosaur Kino Λ; magic damage is reduced against most enemies, Spear/Bow attacks are nearly useless against the boss, and the hardest tier can spawn extra adds -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.kino.spinetrich.title: Spinetrich Kino Strikes Back
tb1.kino.spinetrich.credit: Repeatable event quest to recruit Spinetrich Kino Λ; the boss deals double damage to Beastfolk, swaps between spear and sword mid-fight, and heals from lightning damage -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.kino.tiamat.title: Tiamat Kino Strikes Back
tb1.kino.tiamat.credit: Repeatable event quest to recruit Tiamat Kino Λ; the boss alternates between fire and ice each battle, absorbing/resisting its current element, with physical damage sharply reduced at higher tiers -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.world.cryptidforest.title: Cryptid Forest
tb1.world.cryptidforest.credit: Special zone unlocked after Chapter 4 with two quests that drop job-2/3 upgrade items for the Dracorin companion; a Lucky Runner enemy always spawns and pincering it grants a party-wide Luck boost -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.world.mutohlambda.title: Mutoh Λ
tb1.world.mutohlambda.credit: Very Hard-mode special zone by Chapter 35 with a 4-tier difficulty system gated by story progress (or fixed to the hardest tier during two daily UTC windows); Mutoh Λ is only recruitable at the top tier -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.world.shinenlambda.title: Shin'en Λ
tb1.world.shinenlambda.credit: The paired Very Hard-mode special zone to Mutoh Λ, also by Chapter 35, with the same 4-tier story-gated difficulty system; Shin'en Λ is only recruitable at the top tier -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.world.ultimatefive.title: Ultimate Five
tb1.world.ultimatefive.credit: A series of five elemental boss quests (Garuda/Solar, Gatekeeper/Photon, Quyat/Graviton, Apostolos/Lunar, Agartha/Physical) unlocked after Chapter 19; a Hard Mode variant unlocks after clearing all five on Normal -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.special.8bitrush.title: 8-Bit Rush
tb1.special.8bitrush.credit: A six-battle gauntlet (Arena > Special Quests) fighting reskinned 'Strikes Back'-style bosses to earn companions; added in Version 4.7.0, made a permanent Arena fixture in Version 5.5.0 -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.special.chanceencountersarah.title: A Chance Encounter With Sarah
tb1.special.chanceencountersarah.credit: A one-battle Special Quest crossover featuring Sarah and enemies from Terra Battle 2 -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.special.battlechamps.title: Battle Champs
tb1.special.battlechamps.credit: Collaboration quest with mobile game Battle Champs (Little Noah); four branching sub-quests recruit Nia (recodable into Nia Λ) plus companions Maverick★ and Spike★ -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.special.finalfantasyxv.title: Final Fantasy XV
tb1.special.finalfantasyxv.credit: Collaboration event with Final Fantasy XV; three quests (Gladiolus, Ignis, Prompto) offering a chance to recruit Noctis, Cactuar, and Chocobo -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.special.luciaexplorer.title: Lucia the Explorer
tb1.special.luciaexplorer.credit: Four-part quest series to recruit Lucia and her recode materials for Lucia Λ; a young explorer retraces her parents' journey through mysterious doors and keys -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.special.meltingpotbeastfolk.title: Melting Pot Beastfolk
tb1.special.meltingpotbeastfolk.credit: 15-quest series based on Chapter 3 ("Melting Pot") of the main story; rewards include Candy items and unique Omicron III companions for Amimari, Gegonago, and Zuzu -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.special.meltingpothuman.title: Melting Pot Human
tb1.special.meltingpothuman.credit: 15-quest series based on Chapter 3 ("Melting Pot") of the main story; rewards include Candy items and unique Omicron III companions for Ellvern, Harold, Yukken, and Rikken -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.special.meltingpotlizardfolk.title: Melting Pot Lizardfolk
tb1.special.meltingpotlizardfolk.credit: 15-quest series based on Chapter 3 ("Melting Pot") of the main story; rewards include Candy items and unique Omicron III companions for Ra'prow, Sh'berdan, and Ma'curi -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.special.mobiusfinalfantasy.title: Mobius Final Fantasy
tb1.special.mobiusfinalfantasy.credit: Collaboration event with Mobius Final Fantasy; battles branch on party composition and in-combat actions, offering a chance to recruit Echo and Mog -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.special.captivegolem.title: The Captive Golem
tb1.special.captivegolem.credit: Four-part quest series (I-IV) featuring the S-class boss Captive Golem, escalating into Golem of Creation/Destruction; retired content, removed in Version 5.5.0 -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.special.jadedragon.title: Hunting the Jade Dragon
tb1.special.jadedragon.credit: Branching event quest (5-6 escalating battles across up to 4 routes, gated by turn count and cumulative drag time) to recruit Jade Dragon and Nephrite Dragon; retired content, removed in Version 5.5.0; route flowchart compiled from the wiki's own quest breakdown, since no original fan chart survives for this one -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.hunt.bladefalcon.title: The Hunt For Blade Falcon
tb1.hunt.bladefalcon.credit: Single 4-battle quest to recruit Blade Falcon -- 100% recruit chance on first clear, 30% after; enemies are weak to Spear-type skills/characters -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.hunt.bonekiller.title: The Hunt For Bone Killer
tb1.hunt.bonekiller.credit: Single 4-battle quest to recruit Bone Killer -- 100% recruit chance on first clear, 30% after; enemies are weak to Elemental and magical skills -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.hunt.ethereal.title: The Hunt For Ethereal
tb1.hunt.ethereal.credit: Single 4-battle quest to recruit Ethereal -- 100% recruit chance on first clear, 30% after; floor spikes line the screen edges, and enemies are weak to Bow-type skills/characters -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.special.laststory.title: The Last Story
tb1.special.laststory.credit: Collaboration event with Mistwalker's The Last Story, picking up after the original game's ending; branches into five possible endings based on in-battle player actions, offering Zael and Calista as recruits -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.descent.bahamutdescended.title: Bahamut Descended
tb1.descent.bahamutdescended.credit: 5-battle quest (first available Oct 2014) featuring S-class dragon mage Bahamut as a recruitable boss; drops Bahamut (20% if unrecruited) or Blazing Wand -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.descent.bahamutevolved.title: Bahamut Evolved
tb1.descent.bahamutevolved.credit: 5-battle quest featuring Neo Bahamut, Bahamut's evolved form; rewards Bahamut (40% if unrecruited) or Caladbolg, with rare Suzaku/Kujata companion drops -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.descent.bahamutrecoded.title: Bahamut Recoded
tb1.descent.bahamutrecoded.credit: High-difficulty quest reusing Bahamut Ultra's battles with the boss swapped for Bahamut Λ, who can summon Twisters; non-boss enemies are buffed and give double coins/EXP -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.descent.bahamutultra.title: Bahamut Ultra
tb1.descent.bahamutultra.credit: Quest featuring Bahamut Omega, whose defeat can drop Caladcholg; stacking Anti-Fire Capsules is the recommended strategy against his Meteor attack -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.descent.leviathandescended.title: Leviathan Descended
tb1.descent.leviathandescended.credit: 5-battle quest featuring S-class dragon mage Leviathan as a recruitable boss; drops Leviathan (20% if unrecruited) or Glacial Wand -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.descent.leviathanevolved.title: Leviathan Evolved
tb1.descent.leviathanevolved.credit: 5-battle quest featuring Neo Leviathan; rewards Leviathan (40% if unrecruited) or Cobalt Goblet, with a rare Chiton companion drop -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.descent.leviathanrecoded.title: Leviathan Recoded
tb1.descent.leviathanrecoded.credit: High-difficulty quest reusing Leviathan Ultra's battles with added Time traps and the boss swapped for Leviathan Λ; non-boss enemies are buffed and give double coins/EXP -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.descent.leviathanultra.title: Leviathan Ultra
tb1.descent.leviathanultra.credit: Quest featuring Leviathan Omega, who can drop Trident; Anti-Ice Capsules and Levitation are recommended against his Maelstrom/Icicle attacks -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.descent.odindescended.title: Odin Descended
tb1.descent.odindescended.credit: 5-battle quest featuring S-class celestial knight Odin as a recruitable boss; drops Odin (20% if unrecruited) or Iron Spear -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.descent.odinevolved.title: Odin Evolved
tb1.descent.odinevolved.credit: 5-battle quest featuring Neo Odin, who can drop Amethyst Flame; also offers a rare Wailing Wall companion recruit -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.descent.odinrecoded.title: Odin Recoded
tb1.descent.odinrecoded.credit: High-difficulty quest reusing Odin Ultra's battles with added Kinetic traps and the boss swapped for Odin Λ; non-boss enemies are buffed and give double coins/EXP -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.descent.odinultra.title: Odin Ultra
tb1.descent.odinultra.credit: Quest featuring Odin Omega, who can drop Rune; a physical-damage team with a Disarm Bomb user is recommended against his Zantetsuso attack -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.descent.dragonkingprimordial.title: The Primordial Dragon King
tb1.descent.dragonkingprimordial.credit: One of three sibling Dragon King Descended quests; fights the Primordial Dragon and rewards the SS companion Axion Dragon plus materials to evolve it to Z-class -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.descent.dragonkinginexorable.title: The Inexorable Dragon King
tb1.descent.dragonkinginexorable.credit: One of three sibling Dragon King Descended quests; fights the Axion Dragon and rewards a rare (1%) Primordial Dragon Z companion -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.descent.dragonkingresplendent.title: The Resplendent Dragon King
tb1.descent.dragonkingresplendent.credit: One of three sibling Dragon King Descended quests; fights the Holy Dragon and rewards the SS companion Holy Dragon (only if it doesn't retreat) plus materials to evolve it to Z-class -- via the Terra Battle Wiki

tb1.descent.royalrings.title: Royal Rings Descended
tb1.descent.royalrings.credit: Two-part quest bundling "The Sun King" (3 battles) and "The Moon King" (1 battle); defeating Moon King awards the Sun King and Moon King SS companions respectively, with a rare (1%) Royal Ringstone drop from Sun King -- via the Terra Battle Wiki
